cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - > tests/wide.input.json <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from mk import ktest, enc
NF = 1200
decls = [{"name": "N8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}, {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
modules = []
pipes = []
calls = []
# entry with NF params, NF direct pipes
params = [["p%d" % i, "N8"] for i in range(NF)]
modules.append({"name": "app", "params": params, "result": ["o", "B"], "requires": None})
for i in range(NF):
    modules.append({"name": "f%d" % i, "params": [["q", "N8"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                    "requires": ["lt", ["var", "q"], ["const", "N8", 250]]})
    modules.append({"name": "g%d" % i, "params": [["r", "N8"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                    "requires": ["gt", ["var", "r"], ["const", "N8", 0]]})
    pipes.append({"target": "app", "filter": "f%d" % i, "bind": {"q": "p%d" % i}})
    pipes.append({"target": "f%d" % i, "filter": "g%d" % i, "bind": {"r": "q"}})
campaign = {"types": decls, "modules": modules, "calls": calls, "pipes": pipes,
            "entries": ["app"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
# layout: NF params x0..x{NF-1}, result o x{NF}, flag x{NF+1}
runs = []
for r in range(40):
    objs = [("x%d" % i, enc(1 + (r % 3), 1)) for i in range(NF)]
    objs.append(("x%d" % NF, enc(1, 1)))
    objs.append(("x%d" % (NF + 1), enc(0, 1)))
    runs.append({"entry": "app", "ktest": ktest(objs)})
# one attestation mismatch
objs = [("x%d" % i, enc(1, 1)) for i in range(NF)]
objs.append(("x%d" % NF, enc(1, 1)))
objs.append(("x%d" % (NF + 1), enc(1, 1)))
runs.append({"entry": "app", "ktest": ktest(objs)})
campaign["runs"] = runs
sys.stderr.write("composed applications per run: %d\n" % (2 * NF))
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(campaign))
PYEOF
time python3 /workspace/project/campaign_cli.py < tests/wide.input.json > /tmp/wide.out && python3 -c "
import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/wide.out'))

print('modules', len(p['modules']), p['modules'][:4], p['modules'][-2:])
print('slots', len(p['slots']), 'flag', p['flag'], 'vars', p['variables'])
print([r['status'] for r in d['records']])
print(len(d['corpus']), d['corpus'][0]['inputs'] if d['corpus'] else '')"
